test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In an election between two candidates, 10% of the voters did not cast their vote and 5% of the votes polled were found invalid. The successful candidate got 55% of the valid votes and won by a majority of 1710 votes. How many voters were enrolled?
solution:
**Given:**

10% of voters did not cast their votes i.e., 90% percent of eligible votes were caste,

In 5% were invalid and the successful candidate got 55% of the valid votes and won by a majority of 1710 votes.

**Calculations:**

55% of votes got by the successful candidate so, the rest votes i.e., (100 - 55)% = 45 % of valid votes got by the unsuccessful candidate.

According to the question,

1710 votes are (55 - 45) % = 10 % of total valid votes.

1710 = 10% of total valid votes

⇒ 1710 = 10% of (95% of the votes cast)

⇒ 1710 = 10% of {95% of (90% of enrolled voters)}

⇒ 1710 = ((10)/(100)) × ((95)/(100)) × ((90)/(100)) enrolled voters

⇒ 1710 × 1000000 = 85500 × enrolled voters

Enrolled voters = 20000

**thereforeNo. of enrolled voters is 20, 000.**
